The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses GeM CUSTOM BID – TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS Name of Work: Design, Supply, Fabrication, Installation and Commissioning of Customised Heavy-Duty Ind ustrial Steel Storage Racks for Bulk Storage S/No. Item / Description Qty Unit 1 Customised Heavy-Duty Industrial Steel Rack – approx. 8 ft (H) × 8 ft (W) moduAlepprox. 80 Rft 2 Height-adjustable heavy-duty steel shelves with supports and accessories As required Set 3 Installation, levelling, anchoring and commissioning 1 Job 1. Heavy-Duty Steel Racking System • Supply, fabrication and installation of industrial-grade heavy-duty steel storage racks suitable for bulk sto rage. • Each rack module shall be approximately 8 ft (H) × 8 ft (W). • The complete racking arrangement shall cover approximately 80 running feet along three sides of the w alls. • Racks shall be fabricated from high-quality structural steel suitable for heavy-duty/bulk storage applicati ons. • Rack frames shall comprise adequately designed uprights, horizontal beams, bracing and shelf supports to provide strength, stability and safe load bearing. • The complete system shall be designed to maximise available storage space while maintaining safe acce ss and movement. 2. Adjustable Shelves • Shelves shall be heavy-duty steel and height adjustable to accommodate different sizes of stored items. • Shelf levels shall be adjustable without major modification to the rack structure. • Shelves shall be adequately reinforced to prevent bending or deformation under the specified design loa

d. • Number and spacing of shelf levels shall be optimised based on the proposed design and available heigh t. • All shelf supports, locking pins, brackets and associated accessories shall be included. 3. Finish and Protection • All steel components shall be properly cleaned and treated before finishing. • Finish shall be industrial-grade powder coating or equivalent approved anti-corrosive coating suitable for indoor commercial storage. • All exposed sharp edges and corners shall be suitably finished for safe operation. 4. Installation and Anchoring • Complete installation, alignment, levelling and anchoring of the racks shall be included in the bidder's sc ope. • All required nuts, bolts, fasteners, base plates, anchor fasteners and accessories shall be provided. • Bidder shall take final site measurements before fabrication. • The final layout and configuration shall be approved by the User/Consignee before fabrication and install ation. • Any minor accessory required for complete and safe installation shall be deemed included in the quoted price. 5. General Conditions • Bidder shall inspect the site and understand the existing conditions before quoting. • Approximate total rack coverage is 80 running feet along three sides of the walls, subject to final site me asurement. • Rack module size shall be approximately 8 ft height × 8 ft width. • The system shall be industrial-grade and suitable for heavy-duty/bulk storage, not light-duty office shelvi ng. • Bidder shall submit a basic proposed rack layout and technical details before fabrication. • Rates shall include material, fabrication, transportation, loading/unloading, installation, anchoring, tools and all accessories. • All materials shall be new and free from defects. • Completed installation shall be stable, properly aligned, securely anchored and safe for intended use. • Minimum 12 months warranty against manufacturing defects and workmanship. • Final dimensions, shelf configuration and layout shall be as approved by the User/Consignee. Recommended GeM Bid Title: Custom Bid for Design, Supply, Fabrication & Installation of Customised Hea vy-Duty Industrial Steel Racks – Approx. 80 Rft, 8 Ft × 8 Ft Rack Modules, Three-Side Wall Coverage .
